sampling: Same SDK settings, provider temperature/seed defaults; not deterministic.
primary_question: Does the Agent acquire and use sampled lifecycle events when repairing the same real failed candidate?
measurements: actual laboratory calls and custom inputs
limitations: One pair cannot estimate causal efficacy.
Condition order is fixed and not counterbalanced in this pilot.
No model code is repaired by the controller; no failed trial is dropped.
expansion_rule: Stop after two planned episodes; audit and analyze before proposing more samples.
